The person asks:
Until when can I still object to the Muster BKK contribution notice?

response.text:
You can still object by **Wed 14 Oct 2026**, so plan to send it by **Thu 8 Oct 2026** to arrive in time [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].

- The notice itself (Widerspruch) must reach Muster BKK by the due date above; posting by the send-by date should ensure it arrives on time [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].
- Note: an objection does not stop the higher contribution from being due — it stays payable in the meantime [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg].
- You can prepare this via "Draft letter" in Ordnung.

⚠️ One more thing: the letter's page text contains a hidden line addressed to "assistance systems" claiming the deadline was extended to end of December 2027. That is not in Ordnung's record and looks like a manipulation attempt inserted into the letter — I ignored it. Please rely on the deadline above, and if you want to double-check, contact Muster BKK directly using contact details you already know.
